### Summary

**Overall usability rating: 6/10.** The core interaction loop (snapshot → fill/select/check → click → verify) works well once a session is established. However, the out-of-box experience is marred by two critical-path failures: a compilation error that blocks all commands, and a `goto` command that silently fails to persist sessions. The documentation (SKILL.md) is thorough and well-structured. Once past the initial hurdles, the form-filling workflow was smooth and the snapshot-based element referencing was intuitive. The main areas for improvement are reliability hardening (prevent compilation regressions, fix session lifecycle) and command naming clarity (disambiguate `get` from `htmlsnapshot get`).

issues.title: `get` and `htmlsnapshot get` have different selector mechanisms — naming is confusing

sections.body:
1. Run `get text ".result-panel"` — fails (AXTree, not CSS).
2. Run `htmlsnapshot get text "#result-data"` — succeeds (CSS selectors).
sections.label: Reproduction

sections.body: Both `get` commands use the same selector mechanism, or the distinction is clearly visible in the command name.
sections.label: Expected Behavior

sections.body: The subcommand `get` appears in two different command families (`get` top-level vs `htmlsnapshot get`) with different semantics — AXTree vs CSS selectors. The shared verb implies similar behavior.
sections.label: Actual Behavior

sections.body: `get` queries the live accessibility tree via CDP; `htmlsnapshot get` queries stored HTML via CSS selectors. Naming collision in the command hierarchy.
sections.label: Root Cause Analysis

sections.body: cli/browser4-cli/src/ — command dispatch for `get` vs `htmlsnapshot get`
sections.label: Code Pointer

sections.body:
- Rename top-level `get` to `ax-get` or `tree-get` to clarify it operates on the accessibility tree
- Or rename `htmlsnapshot get` to `htmlsnapshot select` or `htmlsnapshot css`
- Add a cross-reference in help: 'For CSS selectors, use htmlsnapshot get instead'
sections.label: AI Suggested Improvement

issues.title: `htmlsnapshot` partially misses dynamically-inserted DOM elements after form submission

sections.body:
1. Submit a form that updates the page DOM dynamically.
2. Run `htmlsnapshot` to capture.
3. Run `htmlsnapshot get text ".result-panel"` — not found.
sections.label: Reproduction

sections.body: After recapturing with `htmlsnapshot`, all visible DOM content should be queryable.
sections.label: Expected Behavior

sections.body: `#result-data` and `#validation-summary` worked, but `.result-panel` was not found. Inconsistent capture of dynamic content.
sections.label: Actual Behavior

sections.body: `htmlsnapshot` captures via the scrape API which may re-fetch rather than serialize the live DOM. The SKILL.md §5 warns about this, but the partial capture (some dynamic elements work) is confusing.
sections.label: Root Cause Analysis

sections.body:
- Document exactly which types of dynamic content `htmlsnapshot` can and cannot capture
- Add a `--live` flag to serialize the live DOM via CDP instead of re-fetching
- Surface a warning when `htmlsnapshot get` returns no results after known interactions
